name: Envoi de la newsletter LUMen

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 7 * * *'   # tous les jours à 7h UTC (~8h heure du Cameroun)
  workflow_dispatch:        # bouton "Run workflow" pour tester manuellement

jobs:
  send-newsletter:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Récupérer le code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Installer Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Envoyer la newsletter
        working-directory: scripts
        env:
          BREVO_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.BREVO_API_KEY }}
        run: node send-newsletter.js
